theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_single_plane_of_unit_weights
theorems.statement: ∀ (P N : ℕ) (m ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (w : Fin N → Euclid P) (α : Fin N → ℝ), (∀ i, 1 ≤ α i) → ∑ i, α i ≤ 1 → (∃ i, w i = 0) → ν = ∑ i, ENNReal.ofReal (α i) • m.restrict {y : Euclid P | y - w i ∈ V} → ν = m.restrict (V : Set (Euclid P))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
